fills.researcher_notes: Sheet Operator blank. GTSOU has operated Ukraine's gas transmission system since the 1 January 2020 unbundling; this line is a wholly-Ukrainian domestic trunk in Kharkiv/Donetsk Oblast. CAVEAT to carry into the cell's notes: the corridor's eastern end is in an area whose control has changed since 2022, so GTSOU is the operator of record for the system, not a claim about physical access to every kilometre. Independence: counted as two independent origins — ENTSOG's own membership register and Ukrtransgaz/TSOUA's own archived key-facts page. uk.wikipedia is carried as a reading aid for the Ukrainian-language corporate history and is NOT counted toward independence (tertiary encyclopaedia). Same ref triple used across this brief's rows, per the Leg-3 instruction to settle the operator question once per company.

validity.recommendation: Treat this as ONE route defect shared by two rows, not as two length errors. Re-draw or un-share the geometry before either LengthKnownKm is changed; do not lower the lengths on the strength of the drawn trace.
validity.researcher_notes: BOTH Shebelinka–Slovyansk rows (P3381 and P3382) point at ONE shared 7-vertex geojson of 214.9 km, which runs from Oleksiivska hromada, LOZOVA RAION, Kharkiv Oblast to Kryvorizhia, POKROVSK RAION, Donetsk Oblast, with a mid-vertex about 24 km SOUTH of Sloviansk. Shebelynka itself (36.519, 49.458) lies roughly 64 km NORTH of that path. The drawn geometry is therefore not the named corridor at all, so the two route_integrity ratios (3.08 on P3381, 3.99 on P3382) are measuring ONE over-drawn trace twice — they are not evidence of two independent length errors. This is consistent with the PARTIAL_OVERLAP already staged in redundancy cluster D (Ministry Order No. 445 of 12.07.2013, km 1.1–68.0), which is not re-litigated here. Endpoints established by reverse-geocoding every vertex through Nominatim. P3381 is the 1969, 700 mm string; the sheet's 70.00 km sits inside the km 1.1–68.0 span cluster D cites, so the length value is plausible and the route is what is wrong.
